_comment: Data for scripts/docs/python_libs.py (R6). Per distribution: the import names it provides when they differ from its own name, whether it is optional, whether it is never imported (runtime_only: a command, a module run with -m, DLLs), and the note shown in the manual chapter 02 table. skip_dirs are folder names the import scan never enters. files_cap is how many file paths the JSON report keeps per import. unused_check_environments lists the environments whose declared libraries must each be imported somewhere (the docs environment is pinned with its transitives, so it is not checked). docs_direct lists the libraries mkdocs.yml and the build hook need directly; every other line of requirements-docs.txt is transitive. role_table_environments lists the environments shown as the short table (library, pin, direct or transitive role); every other environment gets the full table with imports and users. pip_list_timeout_s is the seconds --drift allows one 'pip list' (R10), chosen 2026-10-22 (it answers in a few seconds on this machine; the ceiling only has to be finite).

PyMuPDF.note: AGPL-3.0 licence; scopus uses it when present without declaring it

docling.note: MIT licence; pulls torch and downloads layout models on first run

MarkupSafe.note: a dependency of Jinja2, imported directly by talk_model.py

pillow.note: also pinned where it is only transitive, to keep the fixed version

pgvector.note: no .py file imports it: the vector store is SQL

playwright.note: the Chromium binary is a separate playwright install chromium

nvidia-cublas-cu12.note: never imported: stt_engine.py puts its DLL folder on PATH for GPU speech-to-text; Windows and Linux only

claude-agent-sdk.note: only the live loop path of loop_engineer.py

tiktoken.note: aider-setup also uses the copy in aider's own interpreter

mineru-llama-cpp.note: the VLM server binary mineru starts

pip-audit.note: run as a module (python -m pip_audit), never imported

numpy.note: aider-setup also imports it, in aider's own interpreter
